description: Promote a successful Python Lab factor or component candidate into a normal validated AlphaLab object, optionally creating a new revision of its source project. Requires a separate explicit write confirmation.
code:
function origin(){return(process.env.ALPHALAB_API_ORIGIN||'http://127.0.0.1:8000').replace(/\/+$/,'')}
async function run(input){if(input.confirm_write!==true)throw new Error('Python Lab promotion requires an explicit user request and confirm_write=true');const id=String(input.run_id||'').trim(),target=String(input.target_id||'').trim();if(!id||!target)throw new Error('run_id and target_id are required');const response=await fetch(origin()+'/api/python-lab/runs/'+encodeURIComponent(id)+'/promote',{method:'POST',headers:{Accept:'application/json','Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({kind:input.kind,target_id:target,apply_to_project:input.apply_to_project===true,confirm_write:true})});if(!response.ok)throw new Error('AlphaLab API '+response.status+': '+await response.text());return response.json()}
